before.sql: UPDATE outbox_event e SET delivered_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE e.event_type LIKE 'g3.%%' AND e.delivered_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consumer_inbox i WHERE i.event_id=e.id AND i.consumer='g3-delivery-v1')

after.sql: UPDATE outbox_event e SET delivered_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE e.tenant_id=%s AND e.event_type='g3.intent.created' AND e.delivered_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consumer_inbox i WHERE i.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND i.event_id=e.id AND i.consumer='g3-delivery-v1')
